updates.title: Updates
updates.dev.hint: This is a development build: its version is not compared with releases, and no update is offered here.
updates.off: The update check is off (UPDATE_CHECK=0). Update on the server with dropsite-update.
updates.check.latest: Checked: you run the latest version.
updates.running.text: The server takes a backup first, then downloads the new version. The panel restarts for about a minute; the sites keep working the whole time.
updates.restarting: Updating… the page reloads by itself.
updates.done.rollback: If something went wrong, go back to the previous version on the server with
updates.failed.hint: The previous version keeps running. Details are in /var/log/dropsite-update.log on the server.
updates.confirm.title: Update dropsite to {version}?
updates.confirm.backup: The server takes a backup first.
updates.confirm.restart: The panel restarts and is unavailable for about a minute.
updates.confirm.rollback: The update can be undone on the server with
updates.manual: The update helper is not installed on this server (manual installation). Update on the server:
updates.need_confirm: Tick "Understood, update now" and press the button again.
updates.requested: The update to {version} was requested. The server starts within a minute.
err.update_check_disabled: The update check is off, or this is a development build.
err.update_check_failed: Could not find out the latest version: GitHub did not answer. Try again later.
err.update_unavailable: This version is not newer than the current one. Check for updates again.
err.update_in_progress: An update is already waiting or running. Wait until it finishes.
err.update_helper_missing: The update helper is not installed on the server. Run dropsite-update on the server.
